l_search.speaker: LUCIEN
lines: Last thing, then I vanish till the bread runs out. At the demarcation they search — hands in every seam. If you carry anything… sensitive — letters, photographs, souvenirs with opinions — better it travels ahead with me. I have pockets the Reich has never imagined.

One more matter and I am gone. The searches on the trains are becoming... intimate. If there is anything on you that argues — papers, keepsakes, anything with words — give it to me tonight and it crosses France without a heartbeat. My pockets are diplomatic territory.

l_search_pressed.speaker: LUCIEN
lines: …And I ask because a little bird in the country says an airman came down with something worth a file in Berlin. Birds exaggerate. But if it were true, that man's pockets would be a debt to every hand that hid him, no?

I ask specially of YOU, my friend, because the country talks — some paper, they say, that fell with an airman and made Berlin sit up. Gossip, surely. But a man carrying such a thing owes it to the line to unload it. No?

choices.text: There was a paper. The schoolmaster kept it. It's gone ahead already.

l_search_open.speaker: LUCIEN
lines: So? Empty pockets, clean seams? Even a photograph of a girl — the censors read love letters like tax men, believe me.
Well? Anything? A letter, a snapshot, a lucky charm with a serial number? The searchers have no romance in them at all.

choices.text: Nothing on me but lint and Madame's soup.
There was something once. A paper. It went to London another way.

l_carry_deflect.speaker: LUCIEN
lines: Lint and soup — the ideal passenger. Then we are done, and I take my curiosity elsewhere. It is my only vice, you know. Everyone should have just the one.
Clean as a collection plate. Good. Forgive the questions — curiosity is my one vice and I feed it so it stays small. Sleep well, my friend.

l_carry_reveal.speaker: LUCIEN
lines: Ahh — so the bird sang true. Gone to London 'another way'… of course. The schoolmaster's way. You see how the line works when it works? Beautiful. Forget I asked, and I will forget you answered.
So there WAS a paper. And the schoolmaster has his own road to London — naturally, naturally. What a machine we are when the parts don't know each other! There — forgotten. Both of us. Completely.
